definitions.explanation: A formal gathering centered around drinking alcohol. More literary and formal than 飲み会, often used for traditional or historical banquets.

examples.japanese: {酒宴|しゅえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{催|もよお}す→催す：11517_moyoosu⟧。
⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}って→祝う：01881_iwau⟧{酒宴|しゅえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A banquet was held to celebrate the marriage.

examples.japanese: {夜遅|よるおそ}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{酒宴|しゅえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{翌朝|よくあさ}→翌朝：03182_yokuasa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{皆|みな}→皆：01810_mina⟧⟦{二日酔|ふつかよ}い→二日酔い：08331_futsukayoi⟧だった。
examples.english: The banquet went on until late at night, and the next morning everyone had a hangover.

notes:
A formal and somewhat literary word. In everyday conversation, ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧ (drinking party) or ⟦{宴会|えんかい}→宴会：04104_enkai⟧ (banquet) are more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒宴|しゅえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{催|もよお}す→催す：11517_moyoosu⟧ (to hold a banquet)
- {酒宴|しゅえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to give a banquet)
- {酒宴|しゅえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (the feast continues)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宴会|えんかい}→宴会：04104_enkai⟧ — general banquet (neutral register)
- ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧ — casual drinking party (informal)
- {酒宴|しゅえん} — drinking feast (literary/formal)
